title: types: the strict authoring face accepts spellings the spec refuses (object-calendar flat keys), 74 zod mirrors silently strip unknown keys, and the list view's options bag is a second contract
body:
> **Premise checked before dispatch** (domain:spec seat 2, 2026-10-26): readings and corrections in comment 6409923362 (https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/25923#issuecomment-6409923362). The goal below is unchanged.

## 维护者速读

三件事同一个病根：objectui 的镜像声明了一些「只读不写」的键，而严格授权面是从声明派生的，于是 `objectui validate` 放行 spec 会拒绝的文档。(1) `StrictAnyComponentSchema` 接受 `object-calendar` 上的扁平 `startDateField`，spec 拒绝并给出处方；gantt 有 32 个同类扁平键。(2) 74 个导出的 zod 镜像是 strip 模式：拼错的键「校验通过」然后消失，spec 会说「Did you mean label」。(3) list view 的顶层 `options` 包被 spec 以 `z.never` 拒绝，objectui 仍声明、仍双读 30 多处、`ObjectView` 仍在合成它。另有 33 个 spec 键 objectui 既不镜像也不声明。

## Measured (runtime probes under tsx against the pinned spec dist 18.0.0; scripts drift2.mts / probe4-6.mts in the review scratchpad)

1. Flat keys on the authoring face
   - `spec ObjectCalendarPropsSchema.safeParse({objectName, startDateField})` → REFUSE "Unrecognized key(s) on this `object-calendar`: `startDateField`. • Write this as a key of the `calendar` config object".
   - `objectui StrictAnyComponentSchema.safeParse({type:'object-calendar', objectName, startDateField})` → ACCEPT. Cause: `objectCalendarFlatField` in `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts` declares the five flat keys and says in its own comment "The flat spelling is read, not authored … `@objectstack/spec` refuses all five" (objectui#8831). The strict face (`packages/types/src/strict-authoring-face.ts`) is derived from declared keys, so prose cannot narrow it.
   - Gantt: `ObjectGanttSchema` in `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` declares 32 live flat keys with no tombstones; the tolerant zod face accepts flat start/end, while the `properties`-bag arm correctly refuses with the spec's text. Readers: `packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx` ("The flat spelling, which `ObjectView` and `ListView` emit") and `packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx` ("The internal flat form — the ObjectView / ListView flatten product").
   - AGENTS.md #0.1 (objectui#6356): a key only the host writes at runtime is typed on a package-local hand-off type, never on the authoring face.
2. Strip-mode mirrors
   - Over every `*Schema` export of `packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts`: passthrough 176, strict 9, **strip 74** (plain `z.object()`). `FormFieldSchema.safeParse({name, type, labell: 'oops'})` → ACCEPT with the key dropped; spec `FormFieldSchema` → REFUSE "Did you mean labell → label". Strip list includes `FormFieldSchema`, `TableColumnSchema`, `DetailViewFieldSchema`, `DetailViewSectionSchema`, `DetailViewTabSchema`, `TabItemSchema`, `KanbanColumnSchema`, `SelectOptionSchema`, `SortConfigSchema`, `FilterGroupSchema`, `DashboardWidgetLayoutSchema`. The TS `FormField` still carries an open index signature (`packages/types/src/form.ts`).
3. The `options` bag
   - Spec `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`: `options: z.never({ error: () => VIEW_ITEM_OPTIONS_REFUSED })`; probe confirms `unrecognized_keys … options`. objectui: `NamedListView.options` is a Record of string to any in `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`; the zod `ListViewSchema.options` is a live 8-kind bag; `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` reads `schema.X || schema.options?.X` at 30+ sites (its header calls the double read "the convention already set by every sibling visualization"); `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` still composes `options: { ...legacyOptions, kanban: … }` from `storedLegacyOptions(viewDef)`.
4. Key drift over 16 zod pairs: **33 spec-only keys** objectui neither mirrors nor types (e.g. `ObjectForm` `contentLayout`, `confirmOnDiscard`; `FormField` `helpText`, `immutable`, `keyField`, `disclosure`, `publicPicker` — 0 TS declarations for those seven, positive control `startDateField` 8), 121 live objectui-only keys; `@object-ui/types/zod` exports an `ActionSchema` (`crud.zod.ts`, `type: 'action'`) sharing 0 keys with the spec's `ActionSchema`; `PageSchema` and `DashboardSchema` have no objectui mirror at all.

## Recommendation

- [ ] Move the calendar (5) and gantt (32) flat keys off the authoring face onto a package-local hand-off type; have `ObjectView` / `ListView` emit the spec block (`calendar: {…}`, `gantt: {…}`); leave `aliasKeyRefusal` tombstones like `dateField` / `endField`. Re-point `calendar-flat-color-allday-8466.test.ts` and the objectui#6576 `schemaReads` census. (M)
- [ ] Make the 74 strip objects `.passthrough()` (the strict twin keeps refusing); drop `FormField`'s index signature (as objectui#12166 did for `step` / `className`); add a "no strip-mode object" assertion beside `assertionNoVacuousEntry` in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` — an existing instrument, not a new gate. (S–M)
- [ ] `options` bag: first a stored-row census (the `body-dialect-census.mjs` pattern) over real console / hotcrm metadata — 未实测; if small, migrate rows, delete the composer in `ObjectView.tsx` and the `InterfaceListPage` twin, then the 30+ double reads and the `NamedListView.options` row, leaving a `z.never` refusal with the spec remedy. (M–L)
- [ ] For each of the 33 spec-only keys: derive by reference (`specFieldsExcept` / `LIST_VIEW_LOCAL_OVERRIDES` pattern) or record a `z.never` refusal; rename or retire the non-spec `ActionSchema` export. (M)

Benefit: `os validate`, `objectui validate` and the renderer give one verdict per document; 37 authorable-but-wrong keys leave the published typings.

Refs: objectui#8831, objectui#11980, objectui#11993, objectui#6356, objectui#5250, objectui#5684, objectui#9256, objectui#7927, objectui#12166, objectui#12014, objectui#11571, objectui#10380, objectui#4115, objectui#11073. No open card covers any of the four.

Filed by the read-only whole-repo review session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BDtwYUWhLGyWLzYQjZ95Cf` on 2026-10-24; the maintainer approved filing (「同意，创建任务」). Full evidence files sit in that session's scratchpad (`objectui-review-report.md`, `findings-*.md`). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.
